about: The terms a title is read in: its register, and the block above or below it. complete_guide.py refuses a title reading outside these lists, and plan.py a page register outside title_register; their counts are what the plan and the build hold titles to. Nothing about an exhibit or a visual is chosen from a list: the digest, the plan briefs and the page library describe every exhibit in the model's own words, and what the code needs of an exhibit (its structure, its marks) it reads from the file (ooxml.exhibit_facts).
